chunks: And from him, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah who said:

I said to Zurara, 'Some people have narrated to me from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) various matters regarding the fixed shares (of inheritance), so I will present them to you. Whatever of them is false, say,

key_terms.زُرَارَة: Zurara ibn A'yan, a prominent Imamite scholar

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on inheritance for the husband and two parents according to Zurara?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the methodology of hadith verification (takhrij) in Shia scholarship, where a trusted narrator like Zurara validates reports against the teachings of the Imams. It specifically confirms the inheritance share of the husband and parents, resolving potential discrepancies in transmitted narrations by affirming the authenticity of Muhammad ibn Muslim's report. This underscores the importance of cross-referencing multiple chains of transmission to ensure doctrinal accuracy in legal matters.
